[size=6][b]PeliQ[/b][/size]
Modder framework, adds some item query related utilities.

See [font=Courier New][CP] PeliQ Examples[/font] for samples.

[size=4][b]Nested Item Queries[/b][/size]
Run 1 item query, then pass it's results to another item query for further processing.
The inner item query goes in [font=Courier New]ModData[/font].

For example, this item query, if placed under a shop Items field, makes that shop sell every kind of fish bait including any modded fish.

[font=Courier New]json
{
"Id": "{{ModId}}_AllBait_Outer",
"ItemId": "ALL_ITEMS (O)",
"PerItemCondition": "ITEM_CONTEXT_TAG Target category_fish",
"ModData": {
"Id": "{{ModId}}_AllBait_Inner",
"ItemId": "FLAVORED_ITEM Bait mushymato.PeliQ_NestedId",
}
}[/font]

The inner item query:

[list]
[*]It is required to have [font=Courier New]mushymato.PeliQ_NestedId[/font] as part of [font=Courier New]ItemId[/font], i.e. cannot use non-ItemId queries here
[*]Alteratively, you can put [font=Courier New]mushymato.PeliQ_NestedId[/font] with [font=Courier New]InputId[/font].
[*]can only nest once
[*]At the moment, this inner query cannot accept certain types, namely lists.
[/list]
The specific flavor of item spawn data used is [font=Courier New]PeliQSpawnItemData[/font] which extends [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Machines]MachineItemOutput[/url] with 1 more field [font=Courier New]InputId[/font] that acts as the machine input.
You can spawn custom flavored items like so:

[font=Courier New]json
"ModData": [
{
"Id": "{{ModId}}_CustomPreserve",
"ItemId": "(O)107", // dino egg
"ObjectDisplayName": "[LocalizedText Strings\\Objects:SmokedFish_Description %PRESERVED_DISPLAY_NAME]",
"ObjectInternalName": "DINO EGG TEST",
"PreserveId": "DROP_IN",
"CopyColor": true,
"InputId": "(O)Moss"
}
][/font]

The outer query's results are passed into the inner as [font=Courier New]InputId[/font] if [font=Courier New]InputId=mushymato.PeliQ_NestedId[/font].

[size=4][b]Stored Item Queries [font=Courier New]mushymato.PeliQ/ItemQueries[/font][/b][/size]
Add a new asset for item queries that can be used by key in various places.
The custom asset is a list of item queries with condition.
This also uses the mentioned [font=Courier New]PeliQSpawnItemData[/font] type.

[font=Courier New]json
{
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "mushymato.PeliQ/ItemQueries",
"Entries": {
"{{ModId}}_Jelly": [
{
"Id": "{{ModId}}_Jelly1",
"ItemId": "(O)CaveJelly",
},
{
"Id": "{{ModId}}_Jelly2",
"ItemId": "(O)RiverJelly",
},
{
"Id": "{{ModId}}_Jelly3",
"ItemId": "(O)SeaJelly",
}
],
"{{ModId}}_Fish": [
{
"Id": "{{ModId}}_Fish",
"ItemId": "ALL_ITEMS (O)",
"PerItemCondition": "ITEM_CONTEXT_TAG Target category_fish",
}
]
}
},[/font]

These can be used in:

[list]
[*]Item queries: [font=Courier New]mushymato.PeliQ_STORED_QUERY <queryId>[/font] in the ItemId of another ItemQuery
[*]Trigger action: [font=Courier New]mushymato.PeliQ_AddItemByQuery <queryId> [ItemQuerySearchMode][/font]
[*]Tile Action and TouchAction: [font=Courier New]mushymato.PeliQ_AddItemByQuery <queryId> [ItemQuerySearchMode] [isDebris][/font]
[*]Mail: [font=Courier New]%peliQ <queryId> [ItemQuerySearchMode] %%[/font] in mail, the items will appear on mail and need to be removed one by one.
[/list]
[size=2][b]ItemQuerySearchMode[/b][/size]
One of:

[list]
[*][font=Courier New]All[/font]
[*][font=Courier New]AllOfTypeItem[/font]
[*][font=Courier New]FirstOfTypeItem[/font]
[*][font=Courier New]RandomOfTypeItem[/font]
[/list]
The default is [font=Courier New]AllOfTypeItem[/font], note that these are applied to every query in the list, so if you have 3 queries that each give 1 specific item (like the [font=Courier New]{{ModId}}_Jelly[/font] example) and use [font=Courier New]RandomOfTypeItem[/font], you will get 3 jellies because 3 item queries have ran. Use fields like [font=Courier New]RandomItemId[/font] to randomize one item query.

[size=2][b]isDebris[/b][/size]
The trigger action always add item directly to player inventory, while the 2 map actions will spawn debris unless isDebris is [font=Courier New]false[/font].

[size=4][b]New Item Queries[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]mushymato.PeliQ_ACTION_SALABLE <itemId>[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Adds a bogus item entry in the shop that doesn't actually buy items.
[*]This is intended to be used for the purpose of creating a shop entry that activates [font=Courier New]ActionsOnPurchase[/font] without giving you an actual item.
[*][font=Courier New]itemId[/font] is not qualified and must be an [font=Courier New]Data/Objects[/font] entry.
[/list]
There are 2 custom fields that can be set on the [font=Courier New]Data/Objects[/font] entry of your placeholder object.

[list]
[*][font=Courier New]mushymato.PeliQ/ExitOnPurchase[/font]: Exit the menu immediately on purchase
[*][font=Courier New]mushymato.PeliQ/PurchaseSound[/font]: Sound to play on purchase
[/list]
[size=4][b]New Game State Queries[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]mushymato.PeliQ_ITEM_ID_REGEX Target|Input <regex>+[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Matches item id or qualified item id against a [url=https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/standard/base-types/regular-expression-language-quick-reference]regular expression (case insensitive)[/url].
[*]First argument is usually Target, but Input if dealing with machine trigger rules.
[/list]
[size=4][b]mushymato.PeliQ_ANY_N "first GSQ" <count> <"GSQ">+[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Evaluate first GSQ, then check that at least [font=Courier New]count[/font] number of the following [font=Courier New]GSQ[/font]'s results equals the first GSQ's result.
[*]For basic usage you can use [font=Courier New]TRUE[/font] or [font=Courier New]FALSE[/font] as the first GSQ.
[*]If the GSQ has spaces, it must be quote escaped.
[/list]
[size=4][b]mushymato.PeliQ_AND "first GSQ" "second GSQ"[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Evaluate 2 GSQ, and check for AND.
[*]Added just for fun, you can already use [font=Courier New]GSQ,GSQ[/font] for AND, and [font=Courier New]ANY "!GSQ" "!GSQ"[/font] for !AND.
[/list]
[size=4][b]mushymato.PeliQ_OR "first GSQ" "second GSQ"[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Evaluate 2 GSQ, and check for AND.
[*]Added just for fun, you can already use [font=Courier New]ANY GSQ GSQ[/font] for OR.
[/list]
[size=4][b]mushymato.PeliQ_XOR "first GSQ" "second GSQ"[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Evaluate 2 GSQ, and check for XOR (aka first does not equal second).
[*]Added just for fun, you can already use [font=Courier New]ANY "GSQ,!GSQ" "!GSQ,GSQ"[/font] for XOR.
[/list]
